{{Lang|Yuanzhi|远知}} is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Yuanzhi can be found on the staircase to the right of the [[Synthesizer]].

{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yuanzhi:''' Excuse me, but did you just get back from the mountain? Did you see Xunwei and Lili?
:'''Yuanzhi:''' They are both researchers from Huaxu Academy, wearing uniforms, and are about my age.
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
::'''Yuanzhi:''' I see, so they did go into the mountain for research.
:{{DIcon}} Nope.
::'''Yuanzhi:''' It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
:{{DIcon}} Maybe, but I can't recall for sure.
::'''Yuanzhi:''' It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' I'd really like to see Xunwai and Lili's work routine. I think I can learn a lot even just by watching them work.
:{{DIcon}} But you're from Hongzhen, so how did you know them?
:'''Yuanzhi:''' There was a blizzard a few days ago. They and Wei took shelter in my house. We chatted and got to know each other.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' From then on, they come to see me whenever they're free and share all kinds of interesting things.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' I never thought I could see the world through such a perspective. Things I thought couldn't be any more ordinary turned out to be so interesting and... valuable.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' Maybe I'm daydreaming here, but I thought perhaps I could become a Huaxu researcher, too, like Xunwei, and Wei
:'''Yuanzhi:''' At least I'm working toward that goal.
:{{DIcon}} Being a researcher takes a lot of effort.
::'''Yuanzhi:''' Lili told me that, too, but I'm determined.
::'''Yuanzhi:''' I think there are very few things in this world that are easy... If they all take an effort anyway, might as well do what you like.
:{{DIcon}} That's a nice aspiration, but how do you plan to achieve it?
:{{DIcon}} Nice aspiration. Good luck.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' I plan to head to Jinzhou to study.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' I must take my first step. More doing, less talking. That's what I learned from Xunwei.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' But before I do that, I want to say goodbye to Yi'an.
:'''Yuanzhi:''' Yi'an is my best friend. We grew up together. I don't want him to be troubled by my decision.
{{Dialogue End}}
